items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Even Dizzy heard New World and said, “I want you to write something for me. I need an introduction.”

ctx.x: Okay. So we’re seeing the extension of that, right on down.

Right on down. Even Dizzy heard New World and said, “I want you to write something for me. I need an introduction.” That turned out to be what he played on his first concert at Carnegie Hall. Alice will know.
That’s a title with social consciousness. Carnegie Hall.
